title.zh: 卷一百六十三 志第一百十六 職官三
title.raw: 卷一百六十三 志第一百十六 職官三 Volume 163 Treatises 116: Offical Posts 3

sentences.zh: 吏部 戶部 禮部 兵部 刑部 工部六部監門 六部架閤。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Personnel, Ministry of Revenue, Ministry of Rites, Ministry of War, Ministry of Justice, and Ministry of Works—the Six Ministries supervisory gate, and the Six Ministries document archive.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Personnel, Ministry of Revenue, Ministry of Rites, Ministry of War, Ministry of Justice, and Ministry of Works; the supervisory gate of the Six Ministries; and the document archive of the Six Ministries.

sentences.zh: 掌文武官吏選試、擬注、資任、遷敘、蔭補、考課之政令，封爵、策勳、賞罰殿最之法 。

translations.literal: It administers the regulations on selection and examination, proposed appointment, qualifications for office, promotion and ranking, hereditary privilege appointment, and performance evaluation of civil and military officials, and the methods for enfeoffment, recording of merit, rewards and punishments, and grading of performance.
translations.idiomatic: It oversees regulations governing the selection, examination, proposed appointments, qualifications, promotions, hereditary appointments, and performance reviews of civil and military officials, as well as the rules for enfeoffment, recording of merit, rewards and punishments, and performance grading.

sentences.zh: 凡文階官之等三十，武選官之等五十有六，幕職州縣官之等七，散官之等九，皆以左 右高下分屬於四選。

translations.literal: In all, there are thirty grades of civil rank officials, fifty-six grades of military selection officials, seven grades of secretariat and prefectural/county officials, and nine grades of honorary officials; all are apportioned among the four selection bureaus according to left-right precedence and higher-lower standing.
translations.idiomatic: Civil rank officials have thirty grades, military selection officials fifty-six, secretariat and local officials seven, and honorary officials nine; each is assigned to one of the four selection bureaus according to rank and precedence.

sentences.zh: 曰尚書左選，文臣京朝官以上及職任非中書首除授者悉掌之。

translations.literal: This is called the Left Selection of the Ministry Director; it oversees in full civil officials from metropolitan court rank and above, and those whose posts are not chiefly appointed by the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Selection of the Ministry Director handles all civil officials from metropolitan court rank upward, and all whose appointments are not chiefly issued by the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 曰尚 書右選，武臣升朝官以上及職任非樞密院除授者悉掌之。

translations.literal: This is called the Right Selection of the Ministry Director; it oversees in full military officials from elevated court rank and above, and those whose posts are not appointed by the Bureau of Military Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Selection of the Ministry Director handles all military officials from elevated court rank upward, and all whose appointments are not issued by the Bureau of Military Affairs.

sentences.zh: 自初任至幕職州縣官，侍郎左 選掌之。

translations.literal: From initial appointment through secretariat and prefectural/county posts, the Left Selection of the Vice Director oversees them.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Selection of the Vice Director handles everyone from first appointment through secretariat and local posts.

sentences.zh: 自副尉以上至從義郎，侍郎右選掌之。

translations.literal: From deputy commandant and above through Follower of Righteousness Gentleman, the Right Selection of the Vice Director oversees them.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Selection of the Vice Director handles ranks from deputy commandant up through Follower of Righteousness Gentleman.

sentences.zh: 若文武官雖不隸左右選，而職任係中書 省、樞密院除授者，其制命誥敕，皆本部奉行。

translations.literal: If civil or military officials, though not subordinate to the Left or Right Selection, hold posts appointed by the Secretariat or the Bureau of Military Affairs, this ministry carries out their imperial orders and patent edicts.
translations.idiomatic: When civil or military officials fall outside the Left and Right Selections but hold posts appointed by the Secretariat or Bureau of Military Affairs, this ministry still issues their commissions and patent edicts.

sentences.zh: 凡應注擬、升移、敘復、蔭補及酬賞、 封贈者，所隸審驗格法上尚書省，法例可否不決應取裁者，亦如之。

translations.literal: For all cases of proposed appointment, promotion or transfer, restoration of rank, hereditary privilege appointment, rewards, and posthumous enfeoffment, the subordinate bureau examines qualifications against regulations and submits to the Ministry; where statutes and precedents are unclear and require a ruling, it is likewise.
translations.idiomatic: For proposed appointments, promotions, restorations of rank, hereditary appointments, rewards, and posthumous honors, the responsible bureau verifies qualifications and forwards the case to the ministry; unclear points of law are handled the same way.

sentences.zh: 若中散大夫、左右 武大夫以上合命詞者，列其遷敘資級、歲月、功過上中書省、樞密院畫旨給告，通書本 部長、貳及所隸郎官。

translations.literal: If Palace Attendant or Left/Right Martial Grandee and above require appointment edicts, it lists their promotion qualifications, dates, and merits and demerits and submits to the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs for endorsed approval and issuance of patents; it notifies the ministry director, vice directors, and responsible bureau directors.
translations.idiomatic: For ranks from Palace Attendant and Left or Right Martial Grandee upward that require formal appointment edicts, the ministry lists promotion qualifications, dates, and merits and demerits, obtains endorsed approval from the Secretariat and Bureau of Military Affairs, issues the patent, and notifies the director, vice directors, and responsible bureau directors.

sentences.zh: 其屬有曰司封，曰司勳，曰考功。

translations.literal: Its subordinate bureaus are called Bureau of Enfeoffments, Bureau of Merits, and Bureau of Evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinate bureaus are the Bureau of Enfeoffments, Bureau of Merits, and Bureau of Evaluation.

sentences.zh: 凡官十有三：尚書一人；

translations.literal: In all there are thirteen posts: one Ministry Director;
translations.idiomatic: There are thirteen posts in all: one Ministry Director;

sentences.zh: 侍郎 一人；

translations.literal: one Vice Director;
translations.idiomatic: one Vice Director;

sentences.zh: 郎中、員外郎，尚書選二人，侍郎選各一人，司封、司勳、考功各一人。

translations.literal: Directors and Assistant Directors: two for the Ministry Director's selections, one each for the Vice Director's selections, and one each for the Bureaus of Enfeoffments, Merits, and Evaluation.
translations.idiomatic: Directors and assistant directors number two for the ministry director's selections, one each for each vice director's selection, and one each for the Bureaus of Enfeoffments, Merits, and Evaluation.

sentences.zh: 舊制有三司，尚書主其一，侍郎二員各主其一，分銓注擬事。

translations.literal: Under the old system there were three bureaus: the Ministry Director headed one, and each of the two Vice Directors headed one, dividing the work of selection and proposed appointment.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system there were three selection bureaus: the ministry director headed one, and each vice director headed another, dividing appointment duties among them.

sentences.zh: 其後，但存尚書銓，餘東 西銓印存而事廢。

translations.literal: Thereafter only the Ministry Director's selection bureau remained; the seals of the Eastern and Western selection bureaus were kept but their functions were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Later only the ministry director's selection bureau remained active; the Eastern and Western bureaus kept their seals but ceased to function.

sentences.zh: 淳化中，又置考課院，磨勘幕府州縣功過，引對黜陟。

translations.literal: In the Chunhua era an Evaluation Bureau was also established to review the merits and demerits of secretariat and prefectural/county officials and summon them for audience to decide promotion or dismissal.
translations.idiomatic: During Chunhua an Evaluation Bureau was added to review local and secretariat officials' records and summon them for audience to decide promotions and dismissals.

sentences.zh: 至道二年，以 其事歸流內銓。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhidao, these duties were transferred to the Flow-Within Selection.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhidao 2 these duties were transferred to the Flow-Within Selection.

sentences.zh: 判流內銓事二人，以御史知雜以上充。

translations.literal: Two supervisors of Flow-Within Selection affairs were appointed, filled by Associate Censor-in-Chief and above.
translations.idiomatic: Two supervisors of Flow-Within Selection affairs were filled by officials of Associate Censor-in-Chief rank and above.

sentences.zh: 掌節度判官以下州府判司、諸縣 令佐擬注對揚、磨勘功過之事。

translations.literal: It oversaw proposed appointments, audience presentations, and review of merits and demerits for military commissioners' staff judges and below, prefectural and circuit judicial aides, and all county magistrates and assistants.
translations.idiomatic: It handled proposed appointments, audiences, and merit reviews for officials from military commissioners' staff judges down through prefectural aides and county magistrates and assistants.

sentences.zh: 判部事二人，以帶職京朝官或無職事朝官充。

translations.literal: Two supervisors of ministry affairs were appointed, filled by metropolitan court officials with titular posts or court officials without substantive duties.
translations.idiomatic: Two supervisors of ministry affairs were filled by metropolitan court officials holding titular posts or officials without substantive duties.

sentences.zh: 凡文吏班 秩品命令一出於中書，而小選院即不復置，本曹但掌京朝官敘服章、申請攝官、訃弔祠 祭，及幕府州縣官格式闕簿、辭謝，拔萃舉人兼南曹甲庫之事。

translations.literal: All civil officials' ranks and appointment orders issued solely from the Secretariat; the Minor Selection Bureau was no longer established, and this bureau only handled metropolitan officials' mourning insignia, applications for acting posts, obituary and sacrificial matters, secretariat and local officials' format registers of vacancies, farewell audiences, outstanding candidates, and concurrently the affairs of the Southern Bureau and Patent Archive.
translations.idiomatic: All civil rank and appointment orders now came from the Secretariat alone. The Minor Selection Bureau was abolished, and this bureau handled only metropolitan officials' mourning insignia, acting appointments, obituaries and sacrifices, local vacancy registers and farewell audiences, outstanding candidates, and the Southern Bureau and Patent Archive.

sentences.zh: 流外銓，掌考試附奉諸 司人吏而已。

translations.literal: The Flow-Outside Selection only oversaw the examination of attached and salaried clerks of the various offices.
translations.idiomatic: The Flow-Outside Selection handled only the examination of attached and salaried clerks in the various offices.

sentences.zh: 南曹掌考驗選人殿最成狀，而送流內銓關試、勾黃、給曆之事。

translations.literal: The Southern Bureau oversaw verifying candidates' performance grades and completed dossiers, and forwarded to the Flow-Within Selection matters of gate examination, yellow-ledger verification, and issuance of service records.
translations.idiomatic: The Southern Bureau verified candidates' performance grades and completed dossiers, and forwarded gate examinations, yellow-ledger checks, and service-record issuance to the Flow-Within Selection.

sentences.zh: 甲庫掌受 制敕黃，關給簽符優牒，選人改名廢置之事。

translations.literal: The Patent Archive oversaw receiving imperial edicts and yellow copies, issuing seal tokens and preferential certificates, and matters of candidates changing names or annulling appointments.
translations.idiomatic: The Patent Archive received imperial edicts and yellow copies, issued seal tokens and preferential certificates, and handled name changes and annulled appointments for candidates.

sentences.zh: 初，淳化三年，置磨勘京朝官院。

translations.literal: Initially, in the third year of Chunhua, a Bureau for Review of Metropolitan Officials was established.
translations.idiomatic: At first, in Chunhua 3, a Bureau for Review of Metropolitan Officials was established.

sentences.zh: 四年， 改。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, it was renamed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, it was renamed.

sentences.zh: 太平興國中，置差遣院，至是併入審官院。

translations.literal: During Taiping Xingguo, an Assignment Bureau was established; at this point it was merged into the Bureau of Official Review.
translations.idiomatic: During Taiping Xingguo an Assignment Bureau was set up; it was now merged into the Bureau of Official Review.

sentences.zh: 置知院二人，以御史知雜以上充。

translations.literal: Two bureau directors were appointed, filled by Associate Censor-in-Chief and above.
translations.idiomatic: Two bureau directors were appointed from the rank of Associate Censor-in-Chief upward.

sentences.zh: （舊 以朝官充。）〉

translations.literal: (Under the old system, court officials filled the posts.)
translations.idiomatic: (Under the old system, court officials filled the posts.)

sentences.zh: 掌考校京朝官殿最，敘其爵秩而詔於朝，分擬內外任使而奏之。

translations.literal: It oversaw reviewing metropolitan officials' performance grades, ranking their titles and ranks and announcing them at court, proposing inside and outside assignments and submitting them.
translations.idiomatic: It reviewed metropolitan officials' performance, ranked their titles and announced the results at court, and proposed capital and provincial assignments for submission.

sentences.zh: 元豐官制行，六曹尚書、侍郎為長貳，郎官理郡守以上資任者為郎中，通判以下資序者 為員外郎。

translations.literal: When the Yuanfeng bureaucratic system was implemented, the directors and vice directors of the six ministries served as chiefs and deputies; bureau directors handling qualifications for prefect and above were called Directors, and those for vice-prefect rank and below were called Assistant Directors.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuanfeng bureaucratic reforms, ministry directors and vice directors served as chiefs and deputies; bureau directors qualified for prefect and above were titled Directors, and those at vice-prefect rank and below were titled Assistant Directors.

sentences.zh: 除授皆視寄祿官，高一品以上者為「行」，下一品者為「守」，下二品以下 者為「試」，品同者不用行、守、試，餘職準此。

translations.literal: Appointments all followed titular salary ranks: one grade higher was designated "acting" 行, one grade lower "holding" 守, two grades or more lower "provisional" 試; same grade did not use acting, holding, or provisional; other posts followed likewise.
translations.idiomatic: Appointments were keyed to titular salary rank: one grade above was "acting," one below was "holding," two or more below was "provisional"; equal rank used none of these; other posts followed the same rule.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，置權尚書，奉賜依守侍郎， 班序在試尚書之下，雜壓在左、右常侍之下。

translations.literal: Early in Yuanyou, acting ministry directors were established, with emoluments following holding vice directors, court precedence below provisional directors, and mixed-rank standing below the Left and Right Regular Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Yuanyou acting ministry directors were created, paid like holding vice directors, seated below provisional directors in court order, and ranked below the Left and Right Regular Attendants in mixed precedence.

sentences.zh: 又置權侍郎，如未歷給事中、中書舍人及 待制以上者，並帶「權」字，祿賜比諫議大夫。

translations.literal: Acting vice directors were also established; those who had not served as Supervising Secretary, Secretariat Drafting Officer, or Awaiting Orders and above all carried the word "acting," with emoluments comparable to Remonstrance and Policy Advisor.
translations.idiomatic: Acting vice directors were added as well; anyone who had not yet served as Supervising Secretary, Secretariat Drafting Officer, or Awaiting Orders and above carried the title "acting," with pay equal to a Remonstrance and Policy Advisor.

sentences.zh: 郎官雖理知州資序，未曾實歷知州及監 司、開封府推官者，止除員外郎。

translations.literal: Even if bureau directors had prefect-level qualifications on paper, those who had never actually served as prefect, transport or intendant commissioner, or Kaifeng judicial officer could only be appointed Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Even when a bureau director's qualifications on paper reached prefect rank, anyone who had never actually served as prefect, transport or intendant commissioner, or Kaifeng judicial officer could be appointed only as Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 又詔，職事官除去「行」字一等。

translations.literal: An edict also removed the "acting" designation by one grade from substantive posts.
translations.idiomatic: An edict also dropped the "acting" designation by one grade for substantive posts.

sentences.zh: 又以六曹職事閑劇 不等，減定員數，事簡者他司兼領，司封、司勳各減郎官一員。

translations.literal: Because the duties of the six ministries varied in urgency, authorized numbers were reduced; lighter bureaus were concurrently headed by other offices; the Bureaus of Enfeoffments and Merits each lost one bureau director.
translations.idiomatic: Because duties across the six ministries differed in urgency, staff quotas were cut; lighter bureaus were placed under concurrent leadership elsewhere; and the Bureaus of Enfeoffments and Merits each lost one bureau director.

sentences.zh: 紹聖初，詔元豐法以行 、守、試制祿三等。

translations.literal: Early in Shaosheng, an edict restored the Yuanfeng system of acting, holding, and provisional ranks with three grades of salary.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shaosheng an edict restored the Yuanfeng salary scheme of three grades for acting, holding, and provisional appointments.

sentences.zh: 元符元年，吏部言：「元祐法，小使臣只降宣劄，但務從簡，於理 未安，請自借職而上依元豐法給告。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yuanfu, the Ministry of Personnel reported: "Under the Yuanyou system, minor envoy officials received only announcement slips, pursuing simplicity but unsound in principle; we request that from borrowed rank upward patents be issued according to the Yuanfeng system.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanfu 1 the Ministry of Personnel reported: "Under Yuanyou rules minor envoy officials received only announcement slips—a simplification that was unsound in principle. We ask that from borrowed rank upward patents be issued under the Yuanfeng system.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The request was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 崇寧元年，詔：「大宗正丞，大理正，諸 寺監丞，太學、武學、律學博士，太學正、錄，諸宮院、諸州教授，堂除外，其吏部闕 不許占差已授未赴及初到任人。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chongning, an edict stated: "Except for appointments from the Hall, posts as Director of the Imperial Clan Court, Chief Justice of the Court of Judicial Review, various directorate assistants, doctors of the Imperial University, Military Academy, and Law Academy, university rectifiers and registrars, and lecturers at palace halls and prefectures—vacancies at the Ministry of Personnel may not be preemptively assigned to those already commissioned but not yet reported, or newly arrived appointees.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongning 1 an edict declared: "Apart from Hall appointments, vacancies at the Ministry of Personnel for posts such as Director of the Imperial Clan Court, Chief Justice of the Court of Judicial Review, directorate assistants, university doctors, university rectifiers and registrars, and palace and prefectural lecturers may not be preemptively filled by those already commissioned but not yet reported, or by newly arrived appointees.

sentences.zh: 」二年，詔：「十年不到部者，依長定格與降一官；

translations.literal: " In the second year, an edict stated: "Those who fail to report to the ministry for ten years shall, under the long-term regulations, be demoted one rank;
translations.idiomatic: " In the second year another edict stated: "Anyone who fails to report to the ministry for ten years shall, under the long-term regulations, be demoted one rank;

sentences.zh: 二 十年以上，則除其籍。

translations.literal: those absent twenty years or more shall be stricken from the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: those absent twenty years or more shall be removed from the rolls.

sentences.zh: 」靖康元年七月，詔以吏部四選逐曹條例編集板行。

translations.literal: " In the seventh month of the first year of Jingkang, an edict ordered compilation and printing of the regulations of each bureau under the Ministry of Personnel's four selection bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month of Jingkang 1 an edict ordered the regulations of each bureau under the Ministry of Personnel's four selection bureaus to be compiled and printed.

sentences.zh: 八月，臣僚 言：「祖宗時未有宗室參部之法，神宗時，始選擇差注一二。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, officials reported: "Under the founding emperors there was no system for imperial clansmen to join the ministry rolls; under Emperor Shenzong, one or two began to be selected for appointment.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month officials reported: "Under the founding emperors there was no rule for imperial clansmen to join the ministry rolls; under Emperor Shenzong only one or two began to be selected for appointment.

sentences.zh: 崇寧初，立法大優，宗室 參選之日在本部名次之上，既壓年月深遠勞效顯著之人，復著名州大郡優便豐厚之處。

translations.literal: Early in Chongning, the law was greatly lenient: when clansmen joined the selection rolls their ministry ranking was placed above others, thereby suppressing those with long years and distinguished service, and also assigning them to famous prefectures and large commanderies with favorable and generous posts.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Chongning the law was far too lenient: when clansmen entered the selection rolls they were ranked above others at the ministry, pushing aside officials with long service and outstanding merit and placing them in prestigious, wealthy prefectures and large commanderies.

sentences.zh: 議者頗欲懲革，不注郡守縣令，與在部人通理名次。

translations.literal: Critics wished to reform this, not appointing them as prefects or county magistrates, and ranking them together with others on the rolls.
translations.idiomatic: Critics wanted to reform the practice by barring appointment as prefect or county magistrate and ranking clansmen together with everyone else on the rolls.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 掌文武二選之法而奉行其制命。

translations.literal: It oversees the regulations of the civil and military selection bureaus and carries out their imperial orders.
translations.idiomatic: It administers the regulations of the civil and military selection bureaus and executes their imperial orders.

sentences.zh: 凡序位有品，寓祿有階，列爵有等，賜勳有給，分任有 職，選官有格，考其功過，計其歲月，辨其位秩，而以序進之。

translations.literal: In all, rank order has grades, titular salary has steps, enfeoffment has degrees, merit awards have allotments, assignments have posts, official selection has criteria; it evaluates merits and demerits, counts months and years, distinguishes rank and precedence, and advances them in order.
translations.idiomatic: Rank has grades, titular salary has steps, enfeoffment has degrees, merit awards have allotments, assignments have posts, and selection has standards; it weighs merits and demerits, counts time in office, distinguishes rank and precedence, and advances officials in due order.

sentences.zh: 凡文臣自京朝官，武臣 自大使臣以上，

translations.literal: In all, civil officials from metropolitan court rank, military officials from grand envoy rank and above,
translations.idiomatic: For civil officials from metropolitan court rank and military officials from grand envoy rank upward,

sentences.zh: （舊內殿崇班以上。）〉

translations.literal: (Formerly from Inner Hall Honored Company and above.)
translations.idiomatic: (Formerly from Inner Hall Honored Company and above.)

sentences.zh: 選授、封爵、功賞、課最之事，所隸官分掌其事 ，兼總於尚書，驗實而後判成。

translations.literal: matters of selection and appointment, enfeoffment, merit rewards, and performance evaluation are divided among subordinate bureaus, collectively overseen by the Ministry Director, verified before final approval.
translations.idiomatic: selection and appointment, enfeoffment, merit rewards, and performance evaluation are divided among subordinate bureaus, overseen by the Ministry Director, and approved only after verification.

sentences.zh: 以天下職事員闕具注於籍，月取其應選者揭而書之，集 官注擬，考閥閱以定其可否。

translations.literal: All vacant substantive posts nationwide are fully recorded in registers; each month eligible candidates are posted in lists; officials are assembled for proposed appointment, and dossiers examined to determine eligibility.
translations.idiomatic: Vacant substantive posts throughout the empire are fully entered in the registers; each month eligible candidates are posted in lists; officials assemble to propose appointments, and dossiers are reviewed to decide who qualifies.

sentences.zh: 若有疑不能決，小事則申請，大事則稟議於尚書省，應論 奏者與郎官同請對。

translations.literal: If doubts arise and a decision cannot be made, minor matters are submitted for instruction, major matters reported to the Ministry for deliberation, and those requiring memorialized discussion are presented jointly with bureau directors.
translations.idiomatic: When doubts remain and no decision can be made, minor matters are submitted for instruction and major ones reported to the ministry for deliberation; cases requiring memorialized discussion are presented together with the bureau directors.

sentences.zh: 大祭祀則奉玉幣以授左僕射，執爵以授左丞。

translations.literal: At grand sacrifices, it presents jade and silk to the Left Grand Counselor and holds the libation cup to the Left Vice Grand Counselor.
translations.idiomatic: At grand sacrifices it presents jade and silk to the Left Grand Counselor and holds the libation cup for the Left Vice Grand Counselor.

sentences.zh: 舊，尚書為所遷官名 ，班左丞上。

translations.literal: Formerly, the Ministry Director held the title of the rank to which he was promoted, with court precedence above the Left Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly the Ministry Director bore the title of the rank to which he had been promoted and took court precedence above the Left Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 自釐正百司，吏部以金紫光祿大夫，戶、禮、兵、刑、工部以銀青光祿大 夫換授，而任六曹尚書者始實領職事。

translations.literal: Since the reorganization of the hundred bureaus, the Ministry of Personnel exchanged for Golden Purple-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, and Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works for Silver Purple-Gleam Grand Master, and those serving as six-ministry directors first actually exercised substantive duties.
translations.idiomatic: After the reorganization of the hundred bureaus, the Ministry of Personnel was exchanged for Golden Purple-Gleam Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Revenue, Rites, War, Justice, and Works for Silver Purple-Gleam Grand Master; only then did those serving as six-ministry directors actually hold substantive duties.

sentences.zh: 左選分案八，置吏三十；

translations.literal: The Left Selection has eight desks, with thirty clerks;
translations.idiomatic: The Left Selection was divided into eight desks with thirty clerks;

sentences.zh: 右選分案六，置吏十有 六。

translations.literal: Another edict ordered that following the old Xi Ning and Yuanfeng system, the ministry establish the Office of Overall Restraint to oversee the fiscal revenues of the Ministry of Revenue, Bureau of Revenue, Bureau of Currency, and Bureau of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict ordered that following the old Xi Ning and Yuanfeng system, the ministry establish the Office of Overall Restraint to oversee the fiscal revenues of the Ministry of Revenue, Bureau of Revenue, Bureau of Currency, and Bureau of Granaries.

sentences.zh: 宣和六年，詔戶部辟官依元豐法。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Xuanhe, an edict ordered that Ministry of Revenue recruitment follow the Yuanfeng law.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe 6 an edict ordered that Ministry of Revenue recruitment follow the Yuanfeng law.

sentences.zh: 尚書 侍郎

translations.literal: Ministry Director, Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: Ministry Director, Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 掌軍國用度，以周知其出入盈虛之數。

translations.literal: Oversees state and army expenditures to fully know the numbers of receipts, disbursements, surplus, and deficit.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw state and army expenditures to fully know the numbers of receipts, disbursements, surplus, and deficit.

sentences.zh: 凡州縣廢置，戶口登耗，則稽其版籍；

translations.literal: For prefectural and county abolitions and establishments and population increase and decline, it examines the household registers;
translations.idiomatic: For prefectural and county abolitions and establishments and population increase and decline, it examined the household registers;

sentences.zh: 若貢賦徵 稅，斂散移用，則會其數而頒其政令焉。

translations.literal: for tribute levies and taxes, collection and dispersal and transfer of use, it tallies the numbers and promulgates the regulations.
translations.idiomatic: for tribute levies and taxes, collection, dispersal, and transfer of use, it tallied the numbers and promulgated the regulations.

sentences.zh: 凡四司所治之事，侍郎為之貳，郎中、員外郎 參領之，獨右曹事專隸所掌侍郎。

translations.literal: For all matters handled by the four bureaus, the Vice Director serves as deputy; Directors and Assistant Directors jointly oversee them—only Right Bureau affairs are exclusively subordinated to the Vice Director in charge.
translations.idiomatic: For all matters handled by the four bureaus, the Vice Director served as deputy; directors and assistant directors jointly oversaw them—only Right Bureau affairs were exclusively subordinated to the Vice Director in charge.

sentences.zh: 若事屬本曹，郡縣監司不能直者，受其訟焉。

translations.literal: If a matter belongs to this bureau and prefectures, counties, and supervisory officials cannot settle it, the bureau receives the lawsuit.
translations.idiomatic: If a matter belonged to this bureau and prefectures, counties, and supervisory officials could not settle it, the bureau received the lawsuit.

sentences.zh: 大饗祀 薦饌，則尚書奉俎，飲福則徹之。

translations.literal: At the Great Offering when offerings are presented, the Ministry Director presents the meat tray; when drinking the blessing, he withdraws it.
translations.idiomatic: At the Great Offering when offerings were presented, the Ministry Director presented the meat tray; when drinking the blessing, he withdrew it.

sentences.zh: 朝會則奏貢物。

translations.literal: At court assemblies he presents the tribute goods.
translations.idiomatic: At court assemblies he presented the tribute goods.

sentences.zh: 左曹分案五，置吏四十；

translations.literal: The Left Bureau is divided into five desks, with forty clerks appointed;
translations.idiomatic: The Left Bureau was divided into five desks, with forty clerks appointed;

sentences.zh: 右曹分案五 ，置吏五十有六。

translations.literal: the Right Bureau is divided into five desks, with fifty-six clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: the Right Bureau was divided into five desks, with fifty-six clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 建炎兵興，嘗以知樞密院張愨提領措置戶部財用，後遷中書侍郎，仍 兼之。

translations.literal: When warfare arose in Jianyan, Zhang Min, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was once appointed to oversee and manage Ministry of Revenue finances; later he was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat but still held the post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When warfare arose in Jianyan, Zhang Min, Commissioner of the Bureau of Military Affairs, was once appointed to oversee and manage Ministry of Revenue finances; later he was transferred to Vice Director of the Secretariat but still held the post concurrently.

sentences.zh: 五年，復以參知政事孟庾提領措置。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Meng Yu, Associate Grand Councillor, was again appointed to oversee and manage.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Meng Yu, Associate Grand Councillor, was again appointed to oversee and manage.

sentences.zh: 後罷，專委戶部長貳。

translations.literal: Later this was abolished and authority was entrusted exclusively to the ministry chiefs and deputies.
translations.idiomatic: Later this was abolished and authority was entrusted exclusively to the ministry chiefs and deputies.

sentences.zh: 左曹分案三：曰戶口 ，掌凡諸路州縣戶口升降，民間立戶分財，科差人丁，典賣屋業，陳告戶絕，索取妻男 之訟。

translations.literal: The Left Bureau is divided into three desks: Household Registers, which handles all matters across circuits of prefectures and counties concerning population increase and decline, popular establishment of separate households and division of property, labor corvée assessment of adult males, mortgage and sale of houses and land, petitions reporting extinct households, and lawsuits to recover wives and sons.
translations.idiomatic: The Left Bureau was divided into three desks: Household Registers, which handled all matters across circuits of prefectures and counties concerning population increase and decline, popular establishment of separate households and division of property, labor corvée assessment of adult males, mortgage and sale of houses and land, petitions reporting extinct households, and lawsuits to recover wives and sons.

sentences.zh: 曰農田，掌農田及田訟務限，奏豐稔，驗水旱蟲蝗，勸課農桑，請佃地土，令佐 任滿賞罰，繳奏諸州雨雪，檢按災傷逃絕人戶。

translations.literal: Farmland, which handles farmland and statutory time limits for field lawsuits, reports bumper harvests, verifies drought, flood, locusts, and pests, encourages farming and sericulture, petitions for tenant cultivation of land, rewards and punishes magistrates and assistants upon completing their terms, submits reports on rain and snow from the circuits, and investigates disaster damage and extinct or fleeing households.
translations.idiomatic: Farmland, which handled farmland and statutory time limits for field lawsuits, reported bumper harvests, verified drought, flood, locusts, and pests, encouraged farming and sericulture, petitioned for tenant cultivation of land, rewarded and punished magistrates and assistants upon completing their terms, submitted reports on rain and snow from the circuits, and investigated disaster damage and extinct or fleeing households.

sentences.zh: 曰檢法，掌凡本部檢法之事，設科有三 ：曰二稅，掌受納、驅磨、隱匿、支移、折變。

translations.literal: Legal Affairs, which handles all investigative and legal matters of this bureau; it has three sections: Two-Taxes, which handles receipt and payment, audit grinding, concealment, transfer of tax burdens, and conversion of tax forms.
translations.idiomatic: Legal Affairs, which handled all investigative and legal matters of this bureau; it had three sections: Two-Taxes, which handled receipt and payment, audit grinding, concealment, transfer of tax burdens, and conversion of tax forms.

sentences.zh: 曰房地，掌諸州樓店務房廊課利，僧道 免丁錢及土貢獻物。

translations.literal: Real Estate, which handles the profit levies on tower shops, lodges, and corridor shops in the circuits, exemption payments for monks and Daoists, and local tribute offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Real Estate, which handled the profit levies on tower shops, lodges, and corridor shops in the circuits, exemption payments for monks and Daoists, and local tribute offerings.

sentences.zh: 曰課利，掌諸軍酒課，比較增虧，知、通等職位姓名，人戶買撲鹽 場酒務租額酒息，賣田投納牙契。

translations.literal: Profit Levies, which handles army wine levies, compares increases and losses, registers the names and posts of prefects, transport commissioners, and the like, tracks household lease purchases of salt fields and wine offices, lease quotas, and wine interest, and records land sales and submitted title deeds.
translations.idiomatic: Profit Levies, which handled army wine levies, compared increases and losses, registered the names and posts of prefects, transport commissioners, and the like, tracked household lease purchases of salt fields and wine offices, lease quotas, and wine interest, and recorded land sales and submitted title deeds.

sentences.zh: 外有開拆、知雜司。

translations.literal: Outside these are the Dispatch and Miscellaneous Affairs desks.
translations.idiomatic: Outside these were the Dispatch and Miscellaneous Affairs desks.

sentences.zh: 右曹分案六：曰常平，掌常平、 農田水利及義倉振濟，戶絕田產，居養鰥、寡、孤、獨之事。

translations.literal: The Right Bureau is divided into six desks: Ever-Normal, which handles Ever-Normal policy, farmland and waterworks, and charity-granary relief, extinct-household property, and care for widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Bureau was divided into six desks: Ever-Normal, which handled Ever-Normal policy, farmland and waterworks, and charity-granary relief, extinct-household property, and care for widowers, widows, orphans, and the childless.

sentences.zh: 曰免役，曰坊場，曰平準 ，各隨其名而任其事。

translations.literal: Exemption-from-Corvée, Market Offices, and Equitable Standards—each according to its name discharges its duties.
translations.idiomatic: Exemption-from-Corvée, Market Offices, and Equitable Standards—each according to its name discharged its duties.

sentences.zh: 曰檢法，曰知雜。

translations.literal: Legal Affairs and Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: Legal Affairs and Miscellaneous Affairs.

sentences.zh: 裁減吏額，左曹四十人，右曹三十人。

translations.literal: Clerk quotas were cut: the Left Bureau forty persons, the Right Bureau thirty persons.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk quotas were cut: the Left Bureau forty persons, the Right Bureau thirty persons.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十 年，詔左藏南庫撥隸戶部。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Chunxi, an edict transferred the Southern Treasury of the Left Storehouse to be subordinated to the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 10 an edict transferred the Southern Treasury of the Left Storehouse to be subordinated to the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 舊制，戶部侍郎二人，中興初，止除長貳、各一員，或止除 尚書若侍郎一員。

translations.literal: Under the old system there were two Vice Directors of the Ministry of Revenue; at the beginning of the Restoration, only one chief and one deputy were appointed each, or sometimes only one Ministry Director or Vice Director was appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old system there were two Vice Directors of the Ministry of Revenue; at the beginning of the Restoration, only one chief and one deputy were appointed each, or sometimes only one Ministry Director or Vice Director was appointed.

sentences.zh: 紹興四年七月，詔戶部侍郎二員，通治左、右曹，自此相承不改。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Shaoxing, an edict ordered two Vice Directors of the Ministry of Revenue to jointly administer the Left and Right Bureaus; thereafter this practice continued unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of Shaoxing 4 an edict ordered two Vice Directors of the Ministry of Revenue to jointly administer the Left and Right Bureaus; thereafter this practice continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 郎中 左曹 右曹 員外郎

translations.literal: Director, Left Bureau, Right Bureau, Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Director, Left Bureau, Right Bureau, Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 掌分曹治事。

translations.literal: Oversees the division of bureaus and administration of affairs.
translations.idiomatic: They oversaw the division of bureaus and administration of affairs.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔省併郎曹，惟戶部五司以職事煩劇不併，仍各置一員。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, an edict ordered consolidation of director bureaus; only the Ministry of Revenue's five bureaus, because their duties were especially complex, were not merged, and one officer each was still appointed.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 an edict ordered consolidation of director bureaus; only the Ministry of Revenue's five bureaus, because their duties were especially complex, were not merged, and one officer each was still appointed.

sentences.zh: 紹興 中，專置提舉帳司，總天下帳狀，以戶部左曹郎官兼之。

translations.literal: During Shaoxing, the Office of Supervising Account Books was specially established to oversee all account records nationwide, held concurrently by a director of the Ministry of Revenue's Left Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shaoxing era the Office of Supervising Account Books was specially established to oversee all account records nationwide, held concurrently by a director of the Ministry of Revenue's Left Bureau.

sentences.zh: 右曹歲具常平錢物總數，每秋 季具冊以聞。

translations.literal: The Right Bureau each year compiles totals of Ever-Normal money and goods; each autumn season it submits a register to report upward.
translations.idiomatic: The Right Bureau each year compiled totals of Ever-Normal money and goods; each autumn it submitted a register to report upward.

sentences.zh: 初置主管左、右曹，總稱戶部郎官。

translations.literal: At first supervisors of the Left and Right Bureaus were appointed, collectively called Ministry of Revenue bureau directors.
translations.idiomatic: At first supervisors of the Left and Right Bureaus were appointed, collectively called Ministry of Revenue bureau directors.

sentences.zh: 紹興七年，閻彥昭乙太府寺丞兼左曹 郎官。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shaoxing, Yan Yanzhao assumed the post of Left Bureau director concurrently while serving as assistant director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 7 Yan Yanzhao assumed the post of Left Bureau director concurrently while serving as assistant director of the Court of the Imperial Treasury.

sentences.zh: 紹興三十二年，徐康正除左曹郎官，自是相承不改。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year of Shaoxing, Xu Kangzheng was appointed Left Bureau director; thereafter this practice continued unchanged.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxing 32 Xu Kangzheng was appointed Left Bureau director; thereafter this practice continued unchanged.

sentences.zh: 是年，又詔：「戶部事有可 疑難裁決者，許長貳與眾郎官聚議，文字皆令連書，有定議，然後付本曹行遣。」

translations.literal: That same year another edict ordered: "For Ministry of Revenue matters that are difficult to decide, the chiefs and deputies and all bureau directors are permitted to assemble for consultation; all documents shall be jointly signed; only after a decision is settled may they be sent to the responsible bureau for execution."
translations.idiomatic: That same year another edict ordered: "For Ministry of Revenue matters that are difficult to decide, the chiefs and deputies and all bureau directors are permitted to assemble for consultation; all documents shall be jointly signed; only after a decision is settled may they be sent to the responsible bureau for execution."

sentences.zh: 度支郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 參掌計度軍國之用，量貢賦稅租之入以為出。

translations.literal: Jointly oversees calculating state and army expenditures, measuring tribute, levies, and tax-rent receipts against disbursements.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly oversaw calculating state and army expenditures, measuring tribute, levies, and tax-rent receipts against disbursements.

sentences.zh: 凡軍須邊備，會其盈虛而通其有無。

translations.literal: For all army supplies and frontier provisions, it reconciles surplus and deficit and balances availability and shortage.
translations.idiomatic: For all army supplies and frontier provisions, it reconciled surplus and deficit and balanced availability and shortage.

sentences.zh: 若中 外祿賜及大禮賞給，皆前期以辨。

translations.literal: For inner and outer salary grants and great-ritual rewards and gifts, all are prepared in advance.
translations.idiomatic: For inner and outer salary grants and great-ritual rewards and gifts, all were prepared in advance.

sentences.zh: 歲終，則會諸路財用出入之數奏於上，而以其副申尚 書省。

translations.literal: At year's end it tallies the receipts and disbursements of fiscal resources from all circuits and memorializes upward, submitting a copy to the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: At year's end it tallied the receipts and disbursements of fiscal resources from all circuits and memorialized upward, submitting a copy to the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 凡小事則擬畫，大事諮其長貳；

translations.literal: For minor matters it drafts plans; for major matters it consults its chiefs and deputies;
translations.idiomatic: For minor matters it drafted plans; for major matters it consulted its chiefs and deputies;

sentences.zh: 應申請更改舉行勘審者，則先檢詳供具。

translations.literal: For matters requiring petitions, changes, implementation, or investigation and review, it first examines details and prepares the requisite documents.
translations.idiomatic: For matters requiring petitions, changes, implementation, or investigation and review, it first examined details and prepared the requisite documents.

sentences.zh: 分案六 ，置吏五十有一。

translations.literal: It is divided into six desks, with fifty-one clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into six desks, with fifty-one clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 凡上供有額，封樁有數，科買有期，皆掌之。

translations.literal: For all tribute quotas to the capital, sealed-reserve amounts, and scheduled procurement levies, it oversees them all.
translations.idiomatic: For all tribute quotas to the capital, sealed-reserve amounts, and scheduled procurement levies, it oversaw them all.

sentences.zh: 有所漕運，則計程而給 其直。

translations.literal: When there is canal transport, it calculates the distance and pays the freight.
translations.idiomatic: When there was canal transport, it calculated the distance and paid the freight.

sentences.zh: 凡內外支供及奉給驛券，賞賜衣物錢帛，先期擬度，時而予之。

translations.literal: For all inner and outer disbursements and provision of post certificates, and rewards of clothing, money, and silk, it plans in advance and grants them at the proper time.
translations.idiomatic: For all inner and outer disbursements and provision of post certificates, and rewards of clothing, money, and silk, it planned in advance and granted them at the proper time.

sentences.zh: 分案五：曰度支 ，曰發運，曰支供，曰賞賜，曰知雜。

translations.literal: It is divided into five desks: Bureau of Revenue, Transport Dispatch, Disbursement Provision, Rewards and Gifts, and Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into five desks: Bureau of Revenue, Transport Dispatch, Disbursement Provision, Rewards and Gifts, and Miscellaneous Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾道四年，置會稽都籍，度支掌之。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Qiandao the Kuaiji General Register was established, administered by the Bureau of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao 4 the Kuaiji General Register was established, administered by the Bureau of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 裁減吏額， 置五十人。

translations.literal: Clerk quotas were cut; fifty persons were appointed.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk quotas were cut; fifty persons were appointed.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十三年，又減四人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chunxi, four more were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 13 four more were cut.

sentences.zh: 金部郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Currency.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Currency.

sentences.zh: 參掌天下給納之泉幣，計其歲之所輸，歸於受藏之府，以待邦國之用。

translations.literal: Jointly oversees the currency received and paid throughout the realm, calculating what is delivered each year and returning it to the receiving treasuries to await use by the state.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly oversaw the currency received and paid throughout the realm, calculating what was delivered each year and returning it to the receiving treasuries to await use by the state.

sentences.zh: 勾考平準、市舶 、榷易、商稅、香、茶、鹽、礬之數，以周知其登耗，視歲額增虧而為之賞罰。

translations.literal: It audits and verifies the numbers for equitable standards, maritime trade, monopoly exchange, commercial taxes, spices, tea, salt, and alum, so as to fully know their increases and losses, and rewards or punishes according to whether annual quotas rise or fall.
translations.idiomatic: It audited and verified the numbers for equitable standards, maritime trade, monopoly exchange, commercial taxes, spices, tea, salt, and alum, so as to fully know their increases and losses, and rewarded or punished according to whether annual quotas rose or fell.

sentences.zh: 凡綱運 不濡滯及負折者，計程帳催理。

translations.literal: For all convoy transport that does not arrive on schedule and for shortages and damages, it calculates the route and pursues settlement in the accounts.
translations.idiomatic: For all convoy transport that did not arrive on schedule and for shortages and damages, it calculated the route and pursued settlement in the accounts.

sentences.zh: 凡造度、量、權、衡，則頒其法式。

translations.literal: For all manufacture of measures, capacity standards, weights, and balances, it promulgates the statutes and forms.
translations.idiomatic: For all manufacture of measures, capacity standards, weights, and balances, it promulgated the statutes and forms.

sentences.zh: 合同取索及奉給、 時賜，審覆而供給之。

translations.literal: For contract collections and provision of stipends and seasonal gifts, it reviews and supplies them.
translations.idiomatic: For contract collections and provision of stipends and seasonal gifts, it reviewed and supplied them.

sentences.zh: 分案六：曰左藏，日右藏，曰錢帛，曰榷易，曰請給，曰知雜。

translations.literal: It is divided into six desks: Left Storehouse, Right Storehouse, Money and Silk, Monopoly Exchange, Request and Provision, and Miscellaneous Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into six desks: Left Storehouse, Right Storehouse, Money and Silk, Monopoly Exchange, Request and Provision, and Miscellaneous Affairs.

sentences.zh: 裁減吏額，共置六十人。

translations.literal: Clerk quotas were cut; sixty persons were appointed in all.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk quotas were cut; sixty persons were appointed in all.

sentences.zh: 淳熙十三年，又減四人。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Chunxi, four more were cut.
translations.idiomatic: In Chunxi 13 four more were cut.

sentences.zh: 倉部郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Granaries.

sentences.zh: 參掌國之倉庾儲積及其給受之事。

translations.literal: Jointly oversees the state's granary storage and its receiving and disbursing affairs.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly oversaw the state's granary storage and its receiving and disbursing affairs.

sentences.zh: 凡諸路收糴折納，以時舉行；

translations.literal: For all circuits' grain purchases and commutations, it carries them out on schedule;
translations.idiomatic: For all circuits' grain purchases and commutations, it carried them out on schedule;

sentences.zh: 漕運上供封樁，以時催 理；

translations.literal: canal transport, tribute to the capital, and sealed reserves are pursued on schedule;
translations.idiomatic: canal transport, tribute to the capital, and sealed reserves were pursued on schedule;

sentences.zh: 應供輸中都而有登耗，則比較以聞。

translations.literal: when what should be delivered to the capital shows gain or loss, it compares and reports upward.
translations.idiomatic: when what should be delivered to the capital showed gain or loss, it compared and reported upward.

sentences.zh: 歲以應用芻粟前期報度支，均定支移、折變之 數。

translations.literal: Each year it reports to the Bureau of Revenue in advance the fodder and grain needed, and fixes the numbers for transfer of tax burdens and conversion of tax forms.
translations.idiomatic: Each year it reported to the Bureau of Revenue in advance the fodder and grain needed, and fixed the numbers for transfer of tax burdens and conversion of tax forms.

sentences.zh: 其在河北、陝西、河東路者，書其所支歲月，季一會之。

translations.literal: In Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong circuits, it records the months and years of disbursements and meets quarterly.
translations.idiomatic: In Hebei, Shaanxi, and Hedong circuits, it recorded the months and years of disbursements and met quarterly.

sentences.zh: 若內外倉場帳籍供申愆期 ，則以法究治。

translations.literal: If inner and outer granary account books and submissions are overdue, it investigates and punishes according to law.
translations.idiomatic: If inner and outer granary account books and submissions were overdue, it investigated and punished according to law.

sentences.zh: 分案六，置吏二十有四。

translations.literal: It is divided into six desks, with twenty-four clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into six desks, with twenty-four clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 元祐元年四月，省郎官一員，十月復置。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the first year of Yuanyou, one bureau director was cut; in the tenth month the post was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Yuanyou 1 one bureau director was cut; in the tenth month the post was restored.

sentences.zh: 分案 六：曰倉場，曰上供，曰糶糴，曰給納，曰知雜，曰開拆。

translations.literal: It is divided into six desks: Granary Fields, Tribute to the Capital, Grain Sales and Purchases, Receipt and Payment, Miscellaneous Affairs, and Dispatch.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into six desks: Granary Fields, Tribute to the Capital, Grain Sales and Purchases, Receipt and Payment, Miscellaneous Affairs, and Dispatch.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，罷司農寺歸倉部 。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan the Court of the Imperial Farm was abolished and its functions returned to the Bureau of Granaries.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 the Court of the Imperial Farm was abolished and its functions returned to the Bureau of Granaries.

sentences.zh: 紹興四年復舊。

sentences.zh: 若祭祀、朝會、宴享，則 同光祿寺官視其善否，酒成則嘗而後進。

translations.literal: For sacrifices, court assemblies, and banquets, it joins Court of Imperial Banquets officials in inspecting quality; when wine is finished it is tasted before being presented.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices, court assemblies, and banquets, it joined Court of Imperial Banquets officials in inspecting quality; when wine was finished it was tasted before being presented.

sentences.zh: 季冬命藏冰，春分啟之，以待供賜。

translations.literal: In late winter it orders ice stored; at spring equinox it is opened to await provision and bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: In late winter it ordered ice stored; at spring equinox it was opened to await provision and bestowal.

sentences.zh: 分案七， 置吏九。

translations.literal: It is divided into seven desks, with nine clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into seven desks, with nine clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 掌兵衛、儀仗、鹵簿、武舉、民兵、廂軍、土軍、蕃軍，四夷官封承襲之事，輿馬、器 械之政，天下地土之圖。

translations.literal: Oversees military guard, ceremonial regalia, honor guard arrays, military examinations, militia, garrison troops, local troops, and frontier troops; enfeoffment and succession for officials of the four directions; regulations on chariots, horses, and weapons; and maps of the realm's territories.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw military guard, ceremonial regalia, honor guard arrays, military examinations, militia, garrison troops, local troops, and frontier troops; enfeoffment and succession for officials of the four directions; regulations on chariots, horses, and weapons; and maps of the realm's territories.

sentences.zh: 凡儀衛，大朝會用黃麾大仗；

translations.literal: For ceremonial guards, great court assemblies use the yellow-banner full guard;
translations.idiomatic: For ceremonial guards, great court assemblies used the yellow-banner full guard;

sentences.zh: 文德殿視朝及冊命王公大臣，用 黃麾半仗；

translations.literal: for audience at Wende Hall and investiture of princes and great ministers, use the yellow-banner half guard;
translations.idiomatic: for audience at Wende Hall and investiture of princes and great ministers, the yellow-banner half guard was used;

sentences.zh: 紫宸殿受外國使朝，用黃麾角仗；

translations.literal: for receiving foreign envoys at Zichen Hall, use the yellow-banner corner guard;
translations.idiomatic: for receiving foreign envoys at Zichen Hall, the yellow-banner corner guard was used;

sentences.zh: 文德殿發冊，用黃麾細仗。

translations.literal: for issuing investiture documents at Wende Hall, use the yellow-banner detailed guard.
translations.idiomatic: for issuing investiture documents at Wende Hall, the yellow-banner detailed guard was used.

sentences.zh: 鹵簿有大駕、 法駕、小駕，皆掌其數及行列先後之儀，為圖以授有司。

translations.literal: Honor guard arrays have grand, legal, and minor escorts; it oversees their numbers and the order of ranks and columns, making diagrams to confer on the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: Honor guard arrays had grand, legal, and minor escorts; it oversaw their numbers and the order of ranks and columns, making diagrams to confer on the responsible offices.

sentences.zh: 凡武選之制，仿貢舉之法。

translations.literal: For military selection, the system follows the civil examination method.
translations.idiomatic: For military selection, the system followed the civil examination method.

sentences.zh: 凡 聯其什伍而教之以戰為民兵，材不中禁衛而足以執役為廂軍，就其鄉井募以御盜為土軍 ，以老疾而裁其功力之半為剩員。

translations.literal: Those linked in tens and fives and trained for battle are militia; those not qualifying for the capital guard but able to perform service are garrison troops; those recruited from their home districts to repel bandits are local troops; those old or ill with labor capacity cut in half are surplus personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Those linked in tens and fives and trained for battle were militia; those not qualifying for the capital guard but able to perform service were garrison troops; those recruited from their home districts to repel bandits were local troops; those old or ill with labor capacity cut in half were surplus personnel.

sentences.zh: 團結以御戎為洞丁，為義軍、弩手；

translations.literal: Those organized to resist barbarians are cave militia, volunteer armies, and crossbowmen;
translations.idiomatic: Those organized to resist barbarians were cave militia, volunteer armies, and crossbowmen;

sentences.zh: 屬羌分隸邊將為 蕃兵。

translations.literal: subordinate Qiang distributed among frontier generals are frontier troops.
translations.idiomatic: subordinate Qiang distributed among frontier generals were frontier troops.

sentences.zh: 籍其名數而頒其禁令。

translations.literal: It registers their numbers and promulgates prohibitions.
translations.idiomatic: It registered their numbers and promulgated prohibitions.

sentences.zh: 大將出征，奏捷則告於廟，破賊則露布以聞。

translations.literal: When great generals campaign, upon victory memorials it reports to the temple; when enemies are defeated it announces via bulletin.
translations.idiomatic: When great generals campaigned, upon victory memorials it reported to the temple; when enemies were defeated it announced via bulletin.

sentences.zh: 凡招置廂、 禁軍及州郡屯營，三衙遷補，守戍軍吏轉補，文武官白直、宣借，皆掌之。

translations.literal: All recruitment of garrison and capital guard troops and prefectural garrisons, Three Commissions transfers and supplements, frontier officer promotions, and civil and military officials' daily attendance and borrowed staff are overseen by it.
translations.idiomatic: All recruitment of garrison and capital guard troops and prefectural garrisons, Three Commissions transfers and supplements, frontier officer promotions, and civil and military officials' daily attendance and borrowed staff were overseen by it.

sentences.zh: 其屬三：曰 職方，曰駕部，曰庫部。

translations.literal: Its subordinates are three: the Bureau of Appointments, Bureau of Transport, and Bureau of Stores.
translations.idiomatic: Its subordinates were three: the Bureau of Appointments, Bureau of Transport, and Bureau of Stores.

sentences.zh: 舊判部事一人，以兩制充。

translations.literal: Formerly one supervising ministry director, filled by a drafted metropolitan official.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one supervising ministry director was appointed, filled by a drafted metropolitan official.

sentences.zh: 掌三駕儀仗、鹵簿圖、春秋釋奠武 成王廟及武舉，歲終以義軍、弓箭手戶數上於朝。

translations.literal: Oversees the three escort arrays, honor guard diagrams, spring and autumn offerings at the Martial King temple and military examinations; at year's end reports the household counts of volunteer armies and archers to court.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw the three escort arrays, honor guard diagrams, spring and autumn offerings at the Martial King temple and military examinations; at year's end it reported the household counts of volunteer armies and archers to court.

sentences.zh: 國初，掌千牛備身，殿中省進馬籍。

translations.literal: At the founding, it managed Thousand-Ox Personal Guards; the Palace Directorate submitted horse registers.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding it managed Thousand-Ox Personal Guards; the Palace Directorate submitted horse registers.

sentences.zh: 元豐設官十，尚書、侍郎各一，四司郎中、員外郎各一。

translations.literal: Under Yuanfeng ten posts were established: one Ministry Director and one Vice Director each, and one Director and Assistant Director for each of the four bureaus.
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuanfeng ten posts were established: one Ministry Director and one Vice Director each, and one director and assistant director for each of the four bureaus.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，省駕部郎中一員，以 職方兼庫部。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, one Bureau of Transport director was cut; the Bureau of Appointments concurrently held the Bureau of Stores.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Yuanyou one Bureau of Transport director was cut; the Bureau of Appointments concurrently held the Bureau of Stores.

sentences.zh: 紹興改元，詔職方、庫部互置郎官一員兼。

translations.literal: When the era name changed at Shaoxing, an edict ordered the Bureaus of Appointments and Stores each to appoint one director to hold the other's post concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: When the era name changed at Shaoxing, an edict ordered the Bureaus of Appointments and Stores each to appoint one director to hold the other's post concurrently.

sentences.zh: 掌兵衛、武選、車輦、甲械、廄牧之政令。

translations.literal: Oversees regulations on military guard, military selection, chariots, armor and weapons, and stable herds.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw regulations on military guard, military selection, chariots, armor and weapons, and stable herds.

sentences.zh: 以天下郡縣之圖而周知其地域。

translations.literal: By maps of prefectures and counties throughout the realm, it fully knows their territorial extent.
translations.idiomatic: By maps of prefectures and counties throughout the realm, it fully knew their territorial extent.

sentences.zh: 凡陳鹵簿， 設仗衛，飭官吏整肅，蕃夷除授，奉行其制命。

translations.literal: For all honor guard arrays displayed, guard units deployed, officials ordered to maintain discipline, and barbarian appointments and removals, it carries out their regulatory commands.
translations.idiomatic: For all honor guard arrays displayed, guard units deployed, officials ordered to maintain discipline, and frontier appointments and removals, it carried out their regulatory commands.

sentences.zh: 凡軍兵以名籍統隸者，閱習按試，選募 遷捕，及武舉、校試之事，皆總之。

translations.literal: For all troops under nominal registers, drill and examination, recruitment, transfer, pursuit, military examinations, and trial examinations are all administered under it.
translations.idiomatic: For all troops under nominal registers, drill and examination, recruitment, transfer, pursuit, military examinations, and trial examinations were all administered under it.

sentences.zh: 侍郎為之貳，郎中、員外郎參掌之。

translations.literal: The Vice Director serves as deputy; Directors and Assistant Directors jointly oversee.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Director served as deputy; directors and assistant directors jointly oversaw.

sentences.zh: 大禮，則尚書 充鹵簿使；

translations.literal: At great rites, the Ministry Director serves as honor guard commissioner;
translations.idiomatic: At great rites, the Ministry Director served as honor guard commissioner;

sentences.zh: 大祀，奉魚牲及俎；

translations.literal: at great sacrifices, presents fish victims and offering trays;
translations.idiomatic: at great sacrifices, presented fish victims and offering trays;

sentences.zh: 視朝，則侍郎執班簿對立；

translations.literal: at court audience, the Vice Director holds the roster and stands opposite;
translations.idiomatic: at court audience, the Vice Director held the roster and stood opposite;

sentences.zh: 小祀，則郎中、員外郎薦俎 并徹。

translations.literal: at minor sacrifices, the Director and Assistant Director present offering trays and withdraw them.
translations.idiomatic: at minor sacrifices, the director and assistant director presented offering trays and withdrew them.

sentences.zh: 分案九，置吏四十有七。

translations.literal: It is divided into nine desks, with forty-seven clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into nine desks, with forty-seven clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 凡蕃夷屬戶授官、封襲之事皆掌之。

translations.literal: All matters of granting office and enfeoffment succession for barbarian dependent households are overseen by it.
translations.idiomatic: All matters of granting office and enfeoffment succession for frontier dependent households were overseen by it.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，併衛尉 寺隸焉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, the Court of Imperial Supplications was merged and subordinated to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 the Court of Imperial Supplications was merged and subordinated to it.

sentences.zh: 分案十：曰賞功，曰民兵衛，曰廂兵，曰人從看詳，曰帳籍告身，曰武舉，曰 蕃官，曰開拆，曰知雜，曰檢法。

translations.literal: It is divided into ten desks: Merit Rewards, Militia Guard, Garrison Troops, Personal Attendant Review, Register Commissions, Military Examination, Frontier Officials, Dispatch, Miscellaneous Affairs, and Legal Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into ten desks: Merit Rewards, Militia Guard, Garrison Troops, Personal Attendant Review, Register Commissions, Military Examination, Frontier Officials, Dispatch, Miscellaneous Affairs, and Legal Affairs.

sentences.zh: 乾道裁減吏額，共置三十人。

translations.literal: In Qiandao clerk quotas were cut; thirty persons were appointed in all.
translations.idiomatic: In Qiandao clerk quotas were cut; thirty persons were appointed in all.

sentences.zh: 續詔：「將下班祗應並 進義校尉、守闕進義副尉、進武校尉、守闕進武副尉並隸兵部，許於殿前司抽差下班祗 應，文字人吏六名，赴部行遣。」

translations.literal: A subsequent edict ordered: "Retired shift attendants of the generals, together with Advance Righteousness Captains, Pending Advance Righteousness Vice Captains, Advance Martial Captains, and Pending Advance Martial Vice Captains are all subordinated to the Ministry of War; they are permitted to be seconded from the Palatial Front Service as retired shift attendants, with six document clerks, to report to the ministry for execution."
translations.idiomatic: A subsequent edict ordered: "Retired shift attendants of the generals, together with Advance Righteousness Captains, Pending Advance Righteousness Vice Captains, Advance Martial Captains, and Pending Advance Martial Vice Captains are all subordinated to the Ministry of War; they may be seconded from the Palatial Front Service as retired shift attendants, with six document clerks, to report to the ministry for execution."

sentences.zh: 侍郎 掌貳尚書之事。

translations.literal: The Vice Director assists the Ministry Director.
translations.idiomatic: The Vice Director assisted the Ministry Director.

sentences.zh: 南渡，長貳互置，續置侍郎二員，紹興常置一員。

translations.literal: After the southern crossing, chiefs and deputies were appointed alternately; later two Vice Directors were established; during Shaoxing one was regularly appointed.
translations.idiomatic: After the southern crossing, chiefs and deputies were appointed alternately; later two Vice Directors were established; during the Shaoxing era one was regularly appointed.

sentences.zh: 郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director.

sentences.zh: 參掌本部長貳之事。

translations.literal: Jointly assists the chiefs and deputies of this bureau.
translations.idiomatic: They jointly assisted the chiefs and deputies of this bureau.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，詔兵部兼職方，駕部兼庫部。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan an edict ordered the Ministry of War to concurrently hold the Bureau of Appointments, and the Bureau of Transport to concurrently hold the Bureau of Stores.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 an edict ordered the Ministry of War to concurrently hold the Bureau of Appointments, and the Bureau of Transport to concurrently hold the Bureau of Stores.

sentences.zh: 隆興元年，詔駕部、兵部 郎官共一員兼領，自是四司合為一矣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longxing an edict ordered the Bureaus of Transport and Ministry of War to share one director concurrently; thereafter the four bureaus were merged into one.
translations.idiomatic: In Longxing 1 an edict ordered the Bureaus of Transport and Ministry of War to share one director concurrently; thereafter the four bureaus were merged into one.

sentences.zh: 厥後間或並置，若從軍或將命於外，則假以為寵 焉。

translations.literal: Afterward they were occasionally established separately; if one followed the army or carried orders abroad, the post was granted as an honor.
translations.idiomatic: Afterward they were occasionally established separately; if one followed the army or carried orders abroad, the post was granted as an honor.

sentences.zh: 職方郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 掌天下圖籍，以周知方域之廣袤，及郡邑、鎮砦道裡之遠近。

translations.literal: Oversees maps and registers throughout the realm, so as to fully know the breadth of territories and the distances of prefectures, counties, forts, and routes.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw maps and registers throughout the realm, so as to fully know the breadth of territories and the distances of prefectures, counties, forts, and routes.

sentences.zh: 凡土地所產，風俗所尚， 具古今興廢之因，州為之籍，遇閏歲造圖以進。

translations.literal: For all local products and prevailing customs, it records the causes of rise and fall through past and present; each circuit keeps a register; in intercalary years maps are made and submitted.
translations.idiomatic: For all local products and prevailing customs, it recorded the causes of rise and fall through past and present; each circuit kept a register; in intercalary years maps were made and submitted.

sentences.zh: 四夷歸附，則分隸諸州，度田屋錢糧之 數以給之。

translations.literal: When the four directions submit, they are distributed among prefectures; the numbers of fields, houses, money, and grain are calculated for provision.
translations.idiomatic: When the four directions submitted, they were distributed among prefectures; the numbers of fields, houses, money, and grain were calculated for provision.

sentences.zh: 分案三，置吏五。

translations.literal: It is divided into three desks, with five clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into three desks, with five clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 舊判司事一人，以無職事朝官充，掌受閏年圖經。

translations.literal: Formerly one supervising bureau director, filled by a metropolitan official without substantive duties, who received intercalary-year gazetteers.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly one supervising bureau director was appointed, filled by a metropolitan official without substantive duties, who received intercalary-year gazetteers.

sentences.zh: 國初， 令天下每閏年造圖納儀鸞司。

translations.literal: At the founding, the empire was ordered each intercalary year to compile maps submitted to the Court of Imperial Insignia.
translations.idiomatic: At the founding the empire was ordered each intercalary year to compile maps submitted to the Court of Imperial Insignia.

sentences.zh: 淳化四年，令再閏一造；

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Chunhua, it was ordered that maps be made every second intercalary year;
translations.idiomatic: In Chunhua 4 it was ordered that maps be made every second intercalary year;

sentences.zh: 咸平四年，令上職方。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xianping, it was ordered that they be submitted to the Bureau of Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In Xianping 4 it was ordered that they be submitted to the Bureau of Appointments.

sentences.zh: 轉運畫本 路諸州圖，十年一上。

translations.literal: Transport commissioners draw maps of prefectures within their circuit; submitted every ten years.
translations.idiomatic: Transport commissioners drew maps of prefectures within their circuit; these were submitted every ten years.

sentences.zh: 紹熙三年，職方、駕部吏額通入兵部、庫部，並作四十二人。

translations.literal: In the third year of Shaoxi, clerk quotas of the Bureaus of Appointments and Transport were absorbed into the Ministry of War and Bureau of Stores, totaling forty-two persons.
translations.idiomatic: In Shaoxi 3 clerk quotas of the Bureaus of Appointments and Transport were absorbed into the Ministry of War and Bureau of Stores, totaling forty-two persons.

sentences.zh: 駕部郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Transport.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Transport.

sentences.zh: 掌輿輦、車馬、驛置、廄牧之事。

translations.literal: Oversees imperial carriages, horses, courier stations, and stable herds.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw imperial carriages, horses, courier stations, and stable herds.

sentences.zh: 大禮，戒有司具五輅。

translations.literal: At great rites, it warns the responsible offices to prepare the five chariots.
translations.idiomatic: At great rites it warned the responsible offices to prepare the five chariots.

sentences.zh: 凡奉使之官赴闕，視其職治給 馬如格。

translations.literal: For all envoys arriving at court on missions, horses are granted according to rank and duties as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: For all envoys arriving at court on missions, horses were granted according to rank and duties as prescribed.

sentences.zh: 官文書則量其遲速以附步馬急遞。

translations.literal: For official documents, it gauges speed and attaches them to foot, horse, or express relay.
translations.idiomatic: For official documents it gauged speed and attached them to foot, horse, or express relay.

sentences.zh: 總內外監牧，籍其租入多寡、孳產登耗。

translations.literal: It oversees all inner and outer supervised pastures, registering rent receipts and increase and loss of offspring.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw all inner and outer supervised pastures, registering rent receipts and increase and loss of offspring.

sentences.zh: 凡 市馬於四夷者，溢歲額則賞之。

translations.literal: For all horse purchases from the four directions, when annual quotas are exceeded rewards are given.
translations.idiomatic: For all horse purchases from the four directions, when annual quotas were exceeded rewards were given.

sentences.zh: 分案六，置吏十有三。

translations.literal: It is divided into six desks, with thirteen clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into six desks, with thirteen clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，並太僕寺隸焉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan, the Court of the Imperial Stud was merged and subordinated to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jianyan 3 the Court of the Imperial Stud was merged and subordinated to it.

sentences.zh: 庫部郎中 員外郎

translations.literal: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Stores.
translations.idiomatic: Director and Assistant Director of the Bureau of Stores.

sentences.zh: 掌鹵簿、儀仗、戎器、供帳之事，國之武庫隸焉。

translations.literal: Oversees honor guards, ceremonial regalia, weapons, and provision tents; the state arsenal is subordinate to it.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw honor guards, ceremonial regalia, weapons, and provision tents; the state arsenal was subordinate to it.

sentences.zh: 凡內外甲仗器械，造作繕修，皆有法 式。

translations.literal: For all inner and outer armor, weapons, and equipment, manufacture and repair all follow statutory forms.
translations.idiomatic: For all inner and outer armor, weapons, and equipment, manufacture and repair all followed statutory forms.

sentences.zh: 若御大慶、文德殿，應用鹵簿名數，前期以戒有司。

translations.literal: For imperial celebrations at the Hall of Great Celebrations or Wende Hall, when honor guard numbers are required, the responsible offices are warned in advance.
translations.idiomatic: For imperial celebrations at the Hall of Great Celebrations or Wende Hall, when honor guard numbers were required, the responsible offices were warned in advance.

sentences.zh: 祭祀、喪葬，則給以等差。

translations.literal: For sacrifices and funerals, provision is made according to grade.
translations.idiomatic: For sacrifices and funerals, provision was made according to grade.

sentences.zh: 總 衛尉寺金吾仗司兵匠之數，考其功罪、歲月而以法升降之。

translations.literal: It totals the numbers of military artisans in the Court of Imperial Supplications and Golden Crow Guard Array Office, evaluating merit and fault and time in service to promote or demote by law.
translations.idiomatic: It totaled the numbers of military artisans in the Court of Imperial Supplications and Golden Crow Guard Array Office, evaluating merit and fault and time in service to promote or demote by law.

sentences.zh: 分案四，置吏九。

translations.literal: It is divided into four desks, with nine clerks appointed.
translations.idiomatic: It was divided into four desks, with nine clerks appointed.

sentences.zh: 掌刑法、獄訟、奏讞、赦宥、敘復之事。

translations.literal: Oversees criminal law, lawsuits, memorialized judgments, amnesties, and rehabilitation.
translations.idiomatic: It oversaw criminal law, lawsuits, memorialized judgments, amnesties, and rehabilitation.

sentences.zh: 凡斷獄本於律，律所不該，以敕、令、格式定 之。

translations.literal: All case adjudication is based on the code; where the code does not cover, edicts, commands, precedents, and forms determine it.
translations.idiomatic: All case adjudication was based on the code; where the code did not cover, edicts, commands, precedents, and forms determined it.

sentences.zh: 凡律之名十有二：曰名例，曰禁衛，曰職制，曰戶婚，曰廄庫，曰擅興，曰盜賊， 曰鬥訟，曰詐偽，曰雜律，曰捕亡，曰斷獄。

translations.literal: The code has twelve names: General Principles, Forbidden Guard, Official System, Household and Marriage, Stables and Storehouses, Unauthorized Campaigns, Theft and Banditry, Assault and Litigation, Fraud and Forgery, Miscellaneous Codes, Capture of Fugitives, and Case Adjudication.
translations.idiomatic: The code had twelve titles: General Principles, Forbidden Guard, Official System, Household and Marriage, Stables and Storehouses, Unauthorized Campaigns, Theft and Banditry, Assault and Litigation, Fraud and Forgery, Miscellaneous Codes, Capture of Fugitives, and Case Adjudication.

sentences.zh: 禁於未然之謂令，施於已然之謂敕，設於 此而使彼至之之謂格，設於此而使彼效之之謂式。

translations.literal: What restrains before the fact is called a command; what is applied after the fact is called an edict; what is set here so that may arrive is called a precedent; what is set here so that may be emulated is called a form.

translations.idiomatic: Formerly established under the Armaments Directorate, a separately appointed supervisory official was dispatched, led by an inner attendant.

translations.literal: During Shaoxing it was transferred to the Ministry of Works; the supervisory official was abolished, and Ministry of Works directors and Armaments Directorate officials were sent in rotation daily to inspect and oversee the office;
translations.idiomatic: During Shaoxing it was transferred to the Ministry of Works; the supervisory official was abolished, and Ministry of Works directors and Armaments Directorate officials were sent in rotation daily to inspect and oversee the office;

translations.idiomatic: Later eunuchs again took charge.

translations.idiomatic: Vice Minister of Works Huang Zhong spoke on the matter and requested restoration of subordination.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.idiomatic: The request was approved.

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位， 有旨增置提點官，以內省都知李綽為之，改稱提舉，免隸工部。

translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiaozong took the throne, an edict added supervisory posts; Inner Department Director of Knowledge Li Chuo was appointed, the title was changed to Superintendent, and the office was exempt from subordination to the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 後以御史張震力爭，復 隸工部。

translations.literal: Later Censor Zhang Zhen argued forcefully, and subordination to the Ministry of Works was restored.
translations.idiomatic: Later Censor Zhang Zhen argued forcefully, and subordination to the Ministry of Works was restored.

sentences.zh: 後改隸步軍司，尋復舊。

translations.literal: Later it was transferred to the Infantry Command, but soon restored to the former arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: Later it was transferred to the Infantry Command, but soon restored to the former arrangement.

sentences.zh: 紹熙元年，減省員額，如上制。

translations.literal: Formerly there were officials who managed the document-archive storehouses; in Xuanhe they were abolished; in the fifteenth year of Shaoxing they were re-established—the Ministries of Personnel and Revenue each detailed one officer, Rites and War jointly detailed one, Justice and Works jointly detailed one—styled "Director of a given ministry's document-archive storehouse," upon the request of Zhou Mao, Assistant Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: There had formerly been officials in charge of the Six Ministries document-archive storehouses; they were abolished in Xuanhe and restored in Shaoxing 15. The Ministries of Personnel and Revenue each posted one officer, Rites and War shared one, and Justice and Works shared one, under the title "Director of the [named] Ministry Document Archive," at the request of Zhou Mao of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 喜定八年，又置三省、樞密院架閤官。

translations.idiomatic: In Jiading 8 document-archive officers were also established for the Three Departments and the Bureau of Military Affairs.
